display.purpose: Hero headline only. One per page. Shippori Mincho 300.

headline.purpose: Section headings. One per section. Contains one italic Kiri Forest word.

title.purpose: Menu category headers. Uppercase tracked Jost 500.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy. Jost 300 at 1.85 line-height. Max 65-75ch.

label.purpose: CTAs, nav links, form labels, gallery captions. Uppercase tracked Jost.

japanese.purpose: Decorative atmosphere characters only. Noto Serif JP 300.

shadows.name: panel-contained
shadows.purpose: Three-column menu panel and About mat-board. Reads as a physical object on the page surface.

shadows.name: card-subtle
shadows.purpose: Inset sub-panels within menu columns. Communicates one level of nesting without weight.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: All entrance and state transitions. Ease-out-quart. No bounce.

motion.name: stagger-step
motion.purpose: Delay between staggered items (nav links, hero layers, list items).

components.name: Primary Button (on dark)
components.description: Hero CTA. Transparent fill, white border, uppercase tracked label. Fills white on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 0.85rem 2.5rem; border: 1px solid oklch(99% 0.004 162 / 0.45); color: oklch(99% 0.004 162); background: transparent; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(99% 0.004 162); color: oklch(30% 0.07 162); border-color: oklch(99% 0.004 162); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(54% 0.1 162); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (on light)
components.description: Reservation form submit. Transparent fill, ink border. Fills ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-block; padding: 0.85rem 2rem; border: 1px solid oklch(20% 0.007 162); color: oklch(20% 0.007 162); background: transparent; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(20% 0.007 162); color: oklch(99% 0.004 162); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(43% 0.09 162); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { background: oklch(54% 0.1 162); color: oklch(99% 0.004 162); border-color: oklch(54% 0.1 162); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Bottom-Border Form Input
components.description: Reservation form fields. No box, no radius. Bottom border only, shifts to Kiri Forest on focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Nama Lengkap<input type="text" placeholder="Nama kamu" class="ds-input" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(50% 0.018 60); margin-top: 1.5rem; } .ds-input { background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(20% 0.007 162 / 0.2); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.75rem 0; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 300; color: oklch(20% 0.007 162); outline: none; transition: border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(20% 0.007 162 / 0.3); text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; } .ds-input:focus { border-bottom-color: oklch(43% 0.09 162); }

components.name: Nav Link (scrolled state)
components.description: Desktop navigation link on scrolled (cream) background. Uppercase tracked label, Kiri Forest hover.
components.html: MenuAboutContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2.2rem; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: oklch(50% 0.018 60); transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(43% 0.09 162); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(43% 0.09 162); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Menu Tab Switcher
components.description: Drinks / Food tab with sliding 2px Kiri Forest underline indicator. translateX animation only.
components.css: .ds-tab-group { display: flex; position: relative; } .ds-tab { position: relative; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); outline: none; } .ds-tab { color: oklch(50% 0.018 60); font-weight: 500; } .ds-tab--active { color: oklch(43% 0.09 162); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:hover { color: oklch(43% 0.09 162 / 0.7); } .ds-tab-track { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: oklch(14% 0.007 162 / 0.1); } .ds-tab-indicator { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 50%; height: 2px; background: oklch(43% 0.09 162); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); }

components.name: Gallery Image Cell
components.description: Image cell in the 12-column grid. Scale hover, gradient overlay, bottom-left caption.
components.html: Interior · Lantai 1
components.css: .ds-gallery-cell { position: relative; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-gallery-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-gallery-cell:hover .ds-gallery-img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-gallery-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.6) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 50%, transparent 100%); opacity: 0.8; pointer-events: none; } .ds-gallery-cell:hover .ds-gallery-overlay { background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 100%); } .ds-gallery-caption { position: absolute; bottom: 1rem; left: 1rem; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(99% 0.004 162 / 0.7); transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-gallery-cell:hover .ds-gallery-caption { color: oklch(99% 0.004 162); }

narrative.overview:
This is a space-as-design system. Suge Coffee exists as a physical room before it exists as a website, and every screen decision inherits from that room: considered structure at the large scale, softness at the surface, nothing competing for priority.

The palette is tonal rather than decorative. Kiri Forest (deep emerald) grounds every dark surface. Washi Warm cream holds the light surfaces. Sumi Night charcoal provides absolute contrast. Warmth comes from the cream and wood tones, never from literal warmth colors.

Typography carries the Japanese-architecture read. Shippori Mincho paired with Jost reads as bilingual by design: one face for ceremony, one face for legibility.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, tonal layering — depth through color fields, not shadows
Sharp or barely-rounded corners (0–2px) — the café's architectural reference
Staggered entrance motion, ease-out-quart only, no bounce
Photography is non-optional on any surface implying space or food
Japanese characters used sparingly as atmosphere, never decoration

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Kiri Forest covers no more than 15% of any light-background surface. Its mass is earned by the gallery section and one intentional dark area per page.

rules.name: The No-Invention Rule
rules.body: No new colors on new surfaces. All surface decisions map to one of the eleven named tokens.

rules.name: The One-Italic Rule
rules.body: Each section heading contains exactly one italic word, set in Kiri Forest. Not two. Not zero.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Sections do not announce themselves with tracked uppercase labels above their headings. The heading stands alone or is preceded by something structurally distinct.

rules.name: The Flat-First Rule
rules.body: Shadow is not the first tool for separation. Color contrast, border, and spatial gap separate elements. Shadows appear only when an element needs to read as a discrete physical object.

dos: Do use real photography on every surface that implies food, space, or atmosphere.
Do give each section heading one italic word in Kiri Forest.
Do let section headings stand alone without a kicker.
Do use oklch() for all color declarations.
Do animate with opacity and transform only, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
Do keep body line length to 65–75ch.
Do use tabular-nums on all price and number displays.
Do give the mobile hamburger a dialog element with display-size nav links.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use loud, cluttered generic restaurant templates.
Don't use cold sterile corporate modernism — pure white, thin Helvetica, blue links.
Don't use endless grids of uniform cards for the menu.
Don't use #000, #fff, or any pure-channel hex as a color value.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing.
Don't use monospaced fonts for UI text.
